projectConstellationImprovement.name: Drift Debt Lens
projectConstellationImprovement.goal: Detect when a Project Constellation wiki or summary names a version, verified commit, qualification state, or next action that is superseded by newer project-owned STATUS/manifests/repository evidence.
projectConstellationImprovement.evidence: This pass found Ferrum's wiki several verified checkpoints behind its project-owned STATUS and found Profit Nova's Hermes donor version one release behind within a day.
projectConstellationImprovement.experiment: Build a derived report that compares recorded wiki/summary version and commit markers against current project-owned STATUS.json, package manifests, latest verified product commit, and release evidence without mutating user/project state.
projectConstellationImprovement.acceptance: Read-only and derived; exactly 63 projects remain available; user edits remain authoritative; a drift warning is emitted only when a concrete project-owned/release mismatch is provable; each warning includes the stale value, current evidence, source, and exact reconciliation action; no automatic downgrade or rewrite occurs.
